```json
{
  "winner": "A",
  "reasons": [
    "Idea A is a defined product with a defined user (urban commuter cyclists). Idea B's own source marks it as unconfirmed ('one-line description to confirm', customer 'varies by idea'), so there is no fixed thing to build or sell.",
    "A's demand evidence comes from several independent sources: multiple real products in the category (BikeMaps.org, LaneSpotter, Pointz, WABA Crash Tracker), a $930,000 government grant, and an advocacy org that runs its own reporting tool. B's demand evidence is one reddit thread, viewed through a mirror, and the same thread argues against the premise ('you can just vibe code if you have an idea').",
    "A has a plausible non-consumer buyer to test within 90 days: advocacy nonprofits and municipal Vision Zero programs, which already fund or run hazard-reporting tools. B's only price anchor (CoFoundersLab, $29/mo) is an adjacent co-founder-matching service, not friend-sourced prototyping, and it carries a billing class-action flag.",
    "B's competitors show signs of weak demand or a commodity trap: dummy data, fake profiles, invite-only betas with 30 testers, and many near-identical no-traction projects. B's own Case Against says AI coding tools are eroding the core need.",
    "A's main risk is that no payer was found and every named competitor is free. That is serious, but it is a pricing and buyer question that one person could test directly with a few orgs or cities. B's problems start earlier: the product, the customer, and the demand are all unsettled."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "B's demand evidence is a single reddit post ('Looking for someone to make apps with...') retrieved through a third-party mirror snapshot. It is not a buyer and shows no willingness to pay. The same thread contains a direct rebuttal of the premise, so the brief's only demand signal contradicts itself.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate-to-low confidence. Neither brief shows anyone paying for the core offering. A has no confirmed payer, every named competitor is free, and the one consumer monetization attempt (Pointz) needed $520k of outside funding. So a paying customer within 90 days is uncertain for A too. A wins mainly because B is undefined and its evidence is weaker, not because A has proven revenue."
}
```
